summary: Iter19 — focused regression for the 3 UI polish features (Polish diff modal, Committee scope strip, Copy for Medium). Backend pytest 7/7 PASS + 1 SKIP. Live UI verified the Cycle tabs (5/5), report editor opens, Polish endpoint round-trip wired correctly (returned no-op toast 'AKKI didn't suggest any changes.' for the trivial-body seed report — expected behaviour per the request). BlogAdmin per-row 'Medium' button + draft-tile button confirmed in source with correct data-testids and buildMediumMarkdown helper produces kicker/title/dek/body/tags markdown. Backend GET /api/blog/admin/posts/{slug} 200/auth-gated correctly (admin OK, no-auth 401, non-superadmin 403, unknown slug 404). Committee strip: backend GET /cycle/committees returns [] for ALL of Bramuel's contexts — no committees seeded — so the strip correctly does NOT render in UI. Could not validate the chip-click + scoped POST end-to-end live without seed data.

integration_issues.issue: Could not exercise the diff modal live: the only Tuli draft has body length 68 ("# Q2 2026 board pack\n_No reportee submissions yet for this cycle._") and Polish returned an identical string — toast 'AKKI didn't suggest any changes.' fires (expected per spec). Wiring is correct: PolishDiffModal component imported, polishDraft state set, modal mounted as sibling. To fully validate live, seed a longer draft body or have the LLM produce a meaningful change. Static review of ReportsTab.jsx + PolishDiffModal.jsx confirms data-testids polish-diff-modal/body/accept/reject are correct and onAcceptPolish replaces body via setBody(polished).

Bramuel's six contexts return {"committees": []} from GET /api/contexts/{cid}/cycle/committees so the strip correctly hides per the gate `committees.length > 0`. The credentials.md note claiming 'Tuli Financial Group has committees+reportees seeded' is wrong — Tuli ned ctx fb4df969... has 0 committees AND 0 reportees; only Mawingu (06cc1fc6...) has reportees. Recommend seeding at least one committee on Tuli or adding a seed script so the chip rendering + scoped generate POST can be E2E tested. Schema-level acceptance of committee_id (null + value) verified GREEN against the backend.

Admin login + /app/blog-admin route failed to surface the [data-testid="blog-posts-list"] within 15s in the headless run (likely due to slow first-render of useAuth gate). Backend endpoint GET /api/blog/admin/posts/{slug} is fully green (200 with body, 401 unauth, 403 non-superadmin, 404 unknown). buildMediumMarkdown logic verified by code review — emits **KICKER**, # title, > dek, body, tags. Recommend main agent open /app/blog-admin in a browser and click any row's Medium button, then check clipboard.

critical_code_review_comments: PolishDiffModal.jsx wordDiff() builds full m×n LCS DP table (Uint16Array(m+1) × (n+1)) — for a 4k-word body that's 16M cells × 2 bytes = 32 MB allocation per render. The component is wrapped in useMemo but every modal open allocates it once. Consider Myers diff or chunking on paragraph boundaries before LCS for any body > 1500 tokens. Fine for current board-paper sizes but a foot-gun for long appendices.

ReportsTab.jsx onAcceptPolish() calls setBody(polishDraft.polished) but does NOT auto-save — user must click 'Save edits' to persist. Toast says so ('Polish accepted. Save edits to commit.') but a user who closes the modal/dialog after accept will lose the polish. Consider an auto-save-on-accept or a visual 'unsaved' badge on the textarea.

BlogAdmin.jsx onCopyForMedium() falls back to GET /blog/admin/posts/{slug} only when !p.body. The list endpoint GET /blog/posts?include_drafts=true currently returns posts WITHOUT body fields, so every per-row click triggers a network round-trip — that's fine but worth caching the fetched full doc in state to avoid re-fetching on repeat clicks.

Cycle.jsx — when scopedCommitteeId is set and the user later clicks 'Whole context', the chip toggles but there's no explicit confirmation that already-drafted checklists scoped to a committee are NOT silently mixed with whole-context drafts. UX could surface 'You drafted N for Audit Committee — those will be skipped now' when switching scopes mid-flow.

The /api/contexts/{cid}/cycle/committees endpoint returns 200 with empty array — good. But if the committees collection doesn't exist for older contexts, the UI relies on the strip-hide gate. Recommend a one-time backfill that ensures every context has a (possibly empty) committees doc, so the GET is consistent.
Backend /blog/admin/posts/{slug} correctly excludes _id (projection {_id:0}) — clean. Auth via _require_admin gate verified to 401 unauth and 403 non-superadmin.

rca of the issue: Two seed-data blockers prevent full live verification: (a) Tuli Financial Group ned ctx (fb4df969...) has no committees AND no reportees despite the credentials.md note — confirmed via direct GET; (b) the only Tuli draft report has a 68-char placeholder body, so 'Polish with AKKI' returns the same text and triggers the documented 'no changes' toast (correct behaviour, not a bug, but blocks E2E modal validation).
